# Beyaz İnci Restaurant

> > Beyaz İnci Restaurant – A premier fish and seafood restaurant located on Istanbul's iconic Galata Bridge, offering traditional Turkish meyhane cuisine with stunning Bosphorus and Golden Horn views.

Beyaz İnci combines authentic Turkish dining with live music (fasıl) and a romantic waterfront setting. The restaurant specializes in fresh seafood, traditional breakfast, and evening entertainment, serving both locals and tourists seeking an authentic Istanbul experience on the European side.

## Key Topics

- Galata Bridge (Galata Köprüsü)
- Bosphorus & Golden Horn (Boğaz & Haliç)
- Fresh seafood & fish specialties (Deniz Ürünleri)
- Turkish meyhane culture
- Live Turkish music (Canlı Müzik, Fasıl)
- Romantic dining venues
- Istanbul European side (Avrupa Yakası)
- Traditional Turkish breakfast (Türk Kahvaltısı)
- Waterfront dining experience
- Galata Tower area
- Eminönü district
- Special events & celebrations
- Restaurant reservations
- Discounted dining hours
